title: OauthSigningKeyRotated
description: A token signing key was rotated. Relying parties refetch the JWKS; the retiring key stays published until `retires_at` so tokens in flight verify.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. `none` is prohibited by SPEC 14.2 and is therefore not representable here. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

previous_kid.description: Key being retired. Absent on first issue.

effective_at.description: When the new key began signing.

retires_at.description: When the previous key stops being published in the JWKS.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
